Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship in Belgium.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build/maintain WordPress sites, which has honed my ability to handle multiple projects and deliver measurable results. I am also an AI enthusiast, using tools like ChatGPT and Claude to automate repetitive tasks, and I have experience with Zapier/Make for workflow automation. My technical skills include Canva, Mailchimp, Meta Business, Google Ads, and CRM tools, and I am comfortable with data-driven decision-making.

I am particularly drawn to Pulse Foundation's focus on leveraging AI to streamline operations, as I have implemented similar efficiencies in my own projects. I am eager to bring my organizational skills and technical expertise to support your programs and amplify your impact.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Pulse Foundation Team,

I am excited to apply for the Marketing & Communications Operations Lead position at Pulse Foundation. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and AI-driven automation, I am drawn to your mission of fostering entrepreneurship and creating lasting impact. Your focus on leveraging AI to streamline operations resonates with my own approach to work: I am an efficiency enthusiast who believes in using technology to free up time for high-value strategic tasks.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain client websites in WordPress. This has given me hands-on experience with content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting. I am comfortable with tools like Canva, Mailchimp, Meta Business, Google Ads, and analytics platforms such as Google Analytics and SEMrush. I have also implemented AI agents and automations using Zapier/Make and Claude Projects to handle repetitive tasks, from email filtering to social media captioning, which has significantly improved my productivity.

One of my proudest projects is mirook.com, where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site and implemented structured data and entity optimization to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project taught me how to manage a full communication strategy, from content creation to technical optimization, and how to measure success through KPIs.

I am highly organized, able to work autonomously, and thrive in fast-paced environments. I am also eager to mentor interns and delegate tasks effectively, as I believe in building strong teams. While my Dutch is at B1 level, I am actively improving it, and I am fluent in English.

I would love the opportunity to contribute to Pulse Foundation's impactful programs and help shape internal processes that will endure. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
